EC1: 1. Has continued CDI diarrhea [AND] despite being on a course of antibiotics prescribed for CDI treatment.
EC2: 2. Requires systemic antibiotic therapy for a condition other than CDI.
EC3: 3. Fecal microbiota transplant (FMT) within the past 6 months.
EC4: 4. FMT [AND] with an associated serious adverse event related to the FMT product [OR] or procedure.
EC5: 5. Bezlotoxumab (CDI monoclonal antibodies) if received within the last year.
EC7: 7. An absolute neutrophil count of <1000 cells/µL during Screening.
EC8: 8. Pregnant, [OR] breastfeeding, [OR] or intends to become pregnant during study participation.
